ms.report:
The team finalized the curriculum following a structured peer review to ensure clarity, relevance, and appropriateness for senior secondary school learners. The curriculum was then implemented in a three-week pilot program held in rural Abeokuta South, Ogun State, with 120 students participating.
The following artifacts provide evidence of the milestone’s completion:
・📘 Finalized Curriculum
・📝 Previous Curriculum Draft
・📄 Peer Review Report
・📑 Pilot Implementation Report
・🗣 Stakeholder Report
・📸 Photographic Evidence
・🎥 Video Summary
・📚 Glossary
・🧠 Quizzes and Answer Keys
・👩‍🏫 Teacher’s Aid
・🧾 12Miles Deck Presentation
・📋 12Miles Pilot Testing Summary

The pilot confirmed both the feasibility and positive impact of the curriculum. The average for the quiz is pegged at 50 percent.
Blockchain technology education is still relatively new in Ogun State, We contacted the relevant education regulatory bodies, who clarified that Blockchain technology education does not fall under the formal academic curriculum yet hence official approval is not required or applicable at this stage we introduced as an extracurricular activity to which they expressed interest in the outcome of our project as a potential basis for proposing the formal adoption of blockchain into the state government’s regular academic curriculum.
